scenes.a: Greet the morning. This is The Morning Altar, and this is the hour we keep.

The Morning Altar reads it again, slowly: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory. Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early. I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

The Morning Altar reads it again, slowly: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory. Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early. I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
scenes.sub: THE MORNING ALTAR READS IT AGAIN

scenes.a: Lord, The Morning Altar comes to You about morning mercy.
What this verse promises is what The Morning Altar is asking for on this channel.
scenes.sub: WHAT THIS VERSE PROMISES IS WHAT

scenes.a: Where morning mercy has gone wrong in our lives, stand in for us.
We are not asking for an easier hour at The Morning Altar, but for Your hand in it.
scenes.sub: WE ARE NOT ASKING FOR AN EASIER
